'''BO-N1''' was a [[Service droid/Legends|service droid]], who was working at the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Droid Spa/Legends|spa]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
BO-N1 was voiced by [[Angelique Perrin]], who also voiced [[SN-D1/Legends|SN-D1]] in the same episode.
